_comment: Ratcheting parse-rate floor over the Flix checkout CI pins. Raise it when the grammar improves; never lower it. The gate prints the new rate when it improves; edit this file to lock it in.
_corpusRevision: Pinned in .github/workflows/ci.yml (both jobs check out the same ref). Recorded here so the two cannot silently disagree about what the rate was measured against.
_excluded: Files the Flix repository ships as deliberately-truncated resiliency fixtures are excluded by CorpusCoverageTest and are not part of this rate. The gate fails if one of them ever parses, so the exclusion cannot go stale unnoticed.
